acceptanceNotes: A same-process fake HTTP server is classified as reusable scenario code only.
A real downstream test must use the real app route, real API Key and real infrastructure while keeping the consumer in an independent process.
A mock or controlled model result cannot be labeled REAL_VERIFIED.
No existing test is changed to weaken assertions or manufacture a green result.
